title: Artifact Distillation: Training-Free Transfer from Frontier to Small Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.37680v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Closing the gap between frontier and smaller language models is usually approached by distillation: fine-tuning the small model (student) on a frontier model's (teacher) outputs, which binds transfer to training compute and leaves the transferred knowledge largely opaque. We propose Artifact Distillation: a teacher solves training instances and externalizes its problem-solving procedure into an artifact bank that a student queries at inference time, with no gradient updates. Across four LiveBench tasks, a bank written by Claude Opus 4.5 lets Claude Haiku 4.5 outperform unaided Claude Sonnet 4.5 on spatial reasoning (0.707 vs. 0.647) at 60% of its cost, and reach Sonnet 4.5's level on table joining at 89% of its cost. The same raw bank raises Qwen3.5-27B's pooled score from 0.730 to 0.800, showing that transfer is not confined to the teacher's model family.

translated_title: 产物蒸馏：从前沿模型到小型语言模型的无训练迁移
translated_abstract: 缩小前沿模型与较小语言模型之间的差距通常采用蒸馏方法：在前沿模型（教师）的输出上对小型模型（学生）进行微调，这种方式将知识迁移与训练算力绑定，且迁移的知识很大程度上是不透明的。我们提出了产物蒸馏：由教师模型解决训练实例，并将其解决问题的过程外部化到一个产物库中，学生模型在推理时查询该库，无需任何梯度更新。在四项 LiveBench 任务中，由 Claude Opus 4.5 编写的产物库使 Claude Haiku 4.5 在空间推理任务上以 60% 的成本超越了未辅助的 Claude Sonnet 4.5（0.707 对 0.647），并以 89% 的成本在表格连接任务上达到了 Sonnet 4.5 的水平。同一个原始产物库还将 Qwen3.5-27B 的综合分数从 0.730 提升至 0.800，表明这种知识迁移并不局限于教师模型的同一家族。
tldr: 产物蒸馏让教师模型将解题过程外部化为可查询的产物库，使小型模型在推理时无需任何训练即可实现跨模型家族的知识迁移，以更低成本达到甚至超越更大前沿模型的表现。
en_tdlr: Artifact Distillation enables training-free knowledge transfer by having a teacher model externalize its problem-solving into a queryable artifact bank, allowing smaller models—even from different model families—to match or exceed larger frontier models at a fraction of the cost.
